CustomField.formula: IF ( ISPICKVAL( PickupLocationType__c, 'Pickup Center' ), PickupCenter__r.ShippingStreet & " " & PickupCenter__r.ShippingCity & ' ' & PickupCenter__r.ShippingState & IF ( NOT(ISBLANK( PickupCenter__r.ShippingPostalCode )), ', ' & PickupCenter__r.ShippingPostalCode, '' ) & " " & PickupCenter__r.ShippingCountry, PickupAddress__Street__s & " " & PickupAddress__City__s & ' ' & TEXT(PickupAddress__StateCode__s) & IF ( NOT(ISBLANK( PickupAddress__PostalCode__s )), ', ' & PickupAddress__PostalCode__s, '' ) & " " & TEXT(PickupAddress__CountryCode__s) )
CustomField.label: Pickup Address HTML
